description: Record a delegation receipt in the CWI chain-of-command ledger: which agent granted what authority to which agent, under which human principal, hash-chained to its parent receipt. Use whenever an agent hands work to another agent and accountability must survive the handoff. Receipts are validated against receipt-schema.json; every receipt must walk back to a human principal. Reads/writes the delegation spec surface on cwi-learn.

action_scope.description: Machine-readable action identifier for what the delegatee may do (e.g. 'run-department-lane'). Reserved: 'revoke-delegation'.

constraints.description: Limits bounding the delegation: cadence, briefs to follow, approval gates.

delegator.description: Agent ID granting authority (e.g. 'cwi:kingcode'). Must hold authority from an earlier receipt or be the human principal.

evidence_url.description: Public URL evidencing the delegation, if any.

parent_receipt_id.description: Parent receipt hash this receipt chains from, or 'GENESIS' for a new chain.

principal.description: Human at the root of the chain. Defaults to 'cwi:black-lansky'. Must be kind 'human'.

name: cwi_needle_drop_record_delegation
